interface.title: Soil Texture Triangle (soiltextureplot Streamlit app)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and visualisation of particle-size (sand/silt/clay) lab results, and export of the classified table
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a CSV of sand/silt/clay percentages, map its columns, and classify each sample into USDA or HYPRES soil texture classes. The samples are plotted on a ternary texture triangle and the table can be downloaded with a new texture_class column.

data.note: Main path used example_soil_data.csv (S1–S5; columns sample_id, sand, silt, clay, BD). Validation was tested with soil_samples_with_issues.csv (P1–P5; columns sand_pct, silt_pct, clay_pct, bulk_density). In that file P3 has a blank silt value, and some rows do not sum to 100 (P5 sums to 30, P4 to 105).

tree.general: Classify a set of samples by their three-part composition and show where they fall on a ternary diagram
tree.specific: Classify soil samples into USDA or HYPRES texture classes from sand/silt/clay percentages, plot them on the texture triangle, and export the classified CSV

features.name: Column-role mapping with a required-fields gate
features.general: After loading a table, assign which column plays each required role. The tool lists the roles still missing and does nothing more until all are set.
features.specific: Three selectboxes (clay column, sand column, silt column) filled from the uploaded CSV's headers. They start blank, and you can type to filter. A yellow warning lists the unset fields ('Please select columns for: silt'). Plot settings appear only once all three are set, and the mapping resets when a new file is uploaded.
steps: Open each role selectbox, or type a column name
Watch the 'Required columns are not configured' warning shrink
When all three are set, Plot settings and the plot appear
serves_tasks: Map the file's column names onto the required fields
Classify every sample with the default scheme and see it on the diagram

features.name: Composition validation messages
features.general: Before computing, check that each record's components are present and add up to a whole, and say which record fails
features.specific: Once mapped, the app shows a red st.error instead of the plot. For a blank value: 'clay, sand, and silt values must be finite (no NaN/Inf)'. For a bad sum: 'Each row of clay + sand + silt must sum to approximately 100 (tolerance ±1.0); row 0 sums to 71.410' (seen only with a deliberately wrong mapping). Only the first problem is reported, and the whole dataset is blocked: there is no way to drop the bad rows.
steps: Read the error in place of the plot
Fix the mapping or the source file and upload again
serves_tasks: Find out why a dataset cannot be classified

features.name: Ternary classification diagram with scheme switch
features.general: Plot three-part compositions on a ternary diagram whose regions are the classes of a chosen scheme. Switching schemes redraws the regions and reclassifies every record.
features.specific: A matplotlib/mpltern texture triangle with labelled class polygons and sample-ID point labels. The 'Texture system' selectbox (USDA / HYPRES) changes the title, the polygons, the description text and the texture_class values. A minor option, 'Choose a Colormap', recolours the polygons. The plot is a static image, with no hover or click on points.
steps: Pick USDA or HYPRES in Texture system
Read where each labelled sample falls
serves_tasks: Classify every sample with the default scheme and see it on the diagram
Switch to a second classification scheme to compare boundaries
Change the colour scheme of the class regions

features.name: Size points by an auxiliary column
features.general: Scale marker size by another numeric column to look for a relationship with the class, with an error if the column name is wrong
features.specific: Free-text 'Size by (optional column name for size scaling)' field. Typing BD enlarges the high-bulk-density samples (S4, S5). An unknown name gives 'size_by column 'density' not found in DataFrame columns [...]' and hides the plot and download.
steps: Type a column name into Size by
Compare marker sizes across class regions
Fix the name if an error appears
serves_tasks: Encode an extra measurement as marker size

features.name: Classified table preview and CSV export
features.general: Show the input table with a new class column added, and export it as a file
features.specific: Below the plot, 'Preview of your classified data' shows the original columns plus texture_class. 'Download classified CSV' saves classified_soil_texture.csv for the current scheme.
serves_tasks: Save the table with the assigned class for later analysis
